children: Ambarella reported second quarter fiscal 2027 revenue of $108.1 million, up 13.2% year-over-year, and a GAAP net loss of $6.7 million for the quarter ended July 31, 2026. On a non-GAAP basis, the company reported net income of $8.2 million, or diluted earnings per share of $0.18. Ambarella provided guidance for Q3 FY2027 revenue of $115.0 million to $124.0 million and non-GAAP gross margin of 59.0%–60.0%.
Revenue: $108.1 million for the three months ended July 31, 2026, up 13.2% from $95.5 million a year earlier.
Gross profit: $62.4 million for the quarter; GAAP gross margin 57.7% (non-GAAP gross margin 59.3%).
Operating result: Loss from operations of $8.1 million for the quarter (GAAP).
Net income (loss): GAAP net loss $6.7 million, or loss per diluted share $0.15; non-GAAP net income $8.2 million, non-GAAP diluted EPS $0.18.
Liquidity: Total cash, cash equivalents and marketable debt securities of $272.3 million at quarter end.
Revenue growth was driven by balanced sequential expansion in Automotive and IoT markets with strong adoption of 5nm CV75 and CV72 AI SoCs.
Introduced first stand-alone AI Accelerator, X7, expanding the company’s product portfolio for edge AI applications.
Executed multi-year channel agreements to develop indirect sales through Macnica (technical distributor) and CapGemini (engineering and systems integration), aiming to extend market reach.
Management cited progress on strategic priorities to increase serviceable market (SAM) forecasts for edge AI and Physical AI.
